name: Career Change
aiPrompt: Connect the skills from my previous work to this role in plain language. Be honest that this is a career change, and do not overstate direct experience in the new field.
blocks: I am excited to apply for the {{JOB_TITLE}} role at {{COMPANY_NAME}}. My path to this field has not been a straight line, and I think the ground I have covered is part of what I can offer.
Changing direction has taught me to learn quickly, to ask good questions and to look at familiar problems with fresh eyes. I am ready to put all of that to work for your team.
Thank you for taking the time to read about where I have been and where I want to go next.
